sn9.5:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Ānanda was dwelling among the Kosalans in a certain woodland thicket.
sn9.5:1.2: Now on that occasion the Venerable Ānanda was excessively involved instructing lay people.
sn9.5:1.3: Then the devatā that inhabited that woodland thicket, having compassion for the Venerable Ānanda, desiring his good, desiring to stir up a sense of urgency in him, approached him and addressed him in verse
sn9.5:2.1: “Having entered the thicket at the foot of a tree,
sn9.5:2.2: Having placed Nibbāna in your heart,
sn9.5:2.3: Meditate, Gotama, and don’t be negligent!
sn9.5:2.4: What will this hullabaloo do for you?”
sn9.5:3.1: Then the Venerable Ānanda, stirred up by that deity, acquired a sense of urgency
